title: Bounds on encoded component lengths
statement: For a natural number $L$ and a Boolean word $W$, write $a$ for the first component decoded from $W$, $b$ for the first component decoded from the second component of $W$, $c$ for the first component decoded from the second component of that second component, and $d$ for the second component decoded from the second component of that second component. The property holds exactly when each of $a,b,c,d$ has length at most $L$.
caveat: The pair encoding and component decoders are not defined in the supplied statement.
